sections.h2: Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra dominate the national soybean crop

chart.title: Kharif 2025: Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh far ahead of every other state
chart.source: SOPA, from Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare crop estimates.

sections.means: Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra together account for most of India's soybean area and output, as the table shows.
sections.todo: Use the Kharif 2025 estimates rather than the 2024-25 final when comparing current state output.

sections.h2: Maharashtra out-produced Madhya Pradesh in 2025 despite MP sowing more area

chart.title: Maharashtra overtook Madhya Pradesh on output in Kharif 2025, on higher yield
chart.sub: Production, lakh tonnes, 2024-25 final and Kharif 2025 estimates.

sections.means: The two states swapped places within one year, as Maharashtra's yield of 1,169 kg/ha beat Madhya Pradesh's fall to 889 kg/ha.
sections.todo: Watch the 2025-26 national estimate of 105.36 lakh tonnes before reading the reversal as a trend.

sections.h2: India is the world's largest soy lecithin exporter by shipment count

chart.title: India ships far more soy lecithin than Argentina or China, by shipment count
chart.source: Shipment counts as cited in the post.

sections.means: Lecithin is a byproduct of refining, so India's crushing base yields an export lead even with a large oil deficit.
sections.todo: Check the post's 'What would fix this' list for the proposed remedies before deciding what the lecithin lead means.

sections.h2: India's soy-food sector is early-stage by most industry estimates

chart.title: Vendor estimates: India's tofu market $36.2 million in 2024, $109.1 million by 2035

chart.source: IMARC, Mordor Intelligence and similar vendor reports, as cited in the post.

sections.means: Vendor reports disagree widely on the same year, so these tofu figures show direction, not scale.
